gaps: The high-level candidate grammar changes when lemma families are enabled. The primitive palette is unchanged; this is not primitive-square GCTS or a proof of unrestricted compiler completeness.

Typed parameters range over the closed input/target term pool and declared predicate names of fixed arity. Positive-arity function heads and binder names stay literal. Ground checking does not prove a universal template soundness theorem.

Two seed proofs and their previous native acceptance are disclosed reuse from Notebook 67. New dependent promotion and zero-start policy training are fresh. No earlier policy weights, failure restrictions or lemma families are imported.
Renaming does not establish structural generalization. The longer chain, compound terms and heterogeneous quantifier/equality composition are declared separately.

The primitive and family grammar share identical target roots and input-role count but have different candidate inventories. Ordering controls within the family grammar use the same complete inventory. The ungrouped lane disables lemma group proposals only, not lemma candidates.

Search wall time includes graph/proposals/full trace collection; setup, matching, ground admission, native proof checking, fresh worker peak memory and independent audit costs are reported separately. Memory runner is macOS.
Induction, full Hilbert geometry, external-prover superiority, plane tiling and unrestricted universal proof search remain open.
